outputs.explanation: The lower graphs in panel A are bar charts showing mean ± SD of band intensity quantification across three genotypes (N=4), but only bars with error bars are shown—no individual data points (dots) are overlaid to show the underlying replicate values.
Panel B consists of immunoelectron micrograph images, not a plot of averaged data, so the individual-data-points check does not apply.
Panel C is a western blot image showing HMGB1 and other protein bands across different mitochondrial preparation methods; it contains no plot of averaged data requiring individual data points.
Panel D is a western blot showing proteinase K protection assay results; it is a blot image, not a plot of averaged quantitative data, so this check does not apply.
